thread:
maya: Quick async QTR OKR check — can we do a short status dump here? TL;DR: what shipped, what slipped, owners, and any CR pings. Owners: @liam, @sophia, @raj.

liam: Runtime v2 canary -> shipped api surface + docs. Significant CPU perf wins.
Slipped: dedicated autoscale tuning (needs one more iteration) — estimating +1 week.
PRs needing eyes: https://git.company/repo/pull/4819 (routing fallback) — @sophia please?

sophia: Shipped: token-prefix caching e2e tests and validation harness.
Slipped: quantization tuning for latency-sensitive models (blocked on perf numbers).
PR 4821 (cache + tests) is ready for QA: https://git.company/repo/pull/4821 — tagging @elena.

elena: QA ran a quick smoke on the canary; saw two flaky batching tests. Will triage tomorrow, ETA +2 days.
Blocker: needs infra image with kv-cache fix from @raj to fully validate.

raj: Pushed staging image tag `infra-20260315-kvfix` and restarted the canary. Command used: `kubectl set image deploy/canary infra=registry/infra:20260315-kvfix`
Deploy-bot showed success.
Note: dedicated autoscale still depends on runtime change to handle scale-down races (liam).

dylan (deploy-bot): deploy-bot: staging -> canary deploy complete (tag infra-20260315-kvfix). Logs: https://logs.company/canary/1918765432

maya: CR pings: @sophia can you review @liam's PR 4819? it's small and has the fallback tests. @raj — confirm ETA for prod image and whether we can ship customer comms today.

liam: @sophia pinged on 4819. Autoscale tuning ETA = 3 business days (will post detailed timeline). I'll open a short follow-up doc for rollback policy so product can reference it.

sophia: Reviewed 4819, left one comment about metric names, will approve after that change. Reviewed 4821 — will merge once QA signs off from @elena.

elena: QA update: batching flake root cause is a race in `batcher-worker.js` where window expiry fires before commit. Filed ticket PT-2345. Temporary mitigation: pin batch window to 10ms in config to reduce incidence; validating tomorrow.

maya: Awesome. Action items I'll track in the OKR sheet:
- liam: autoscale tuning + rollout plan (3d)
- raj: confirm prod image tag and coordinate EngOps for rollout
- sophia: merge PRs after fixes + metric rename
- elena: QA verification and close PT-2345
I'll update the OKR spreadsheet by EOD and notify support if we need to delay customer notes.

liam: Ack. I'll also post the rollback policy RFC in #eng-runtime and link here.

sophia: small ask — anyone available for a 30m CR pairing tomorrow 10:30am PST? would speed reviews.

maya: Thanks team :thumbsup: If anything slips further, call it out here and I'll adjust the quarterly milestone flags.
